name: socially
description: Read public social profiles and posts, and search videos, news and trends.

interface.longDescription: Read a public profile or post on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X or Facebook, read a web page, and see what is being published or trending: YouTube videos, news stories and a country's trend board. socially reports what it found and what it could not check as separate answers, so a blocked page is never read as a missing profile. It reads one profile, post or page at a time. It does not sign into social accounts, read private messages, find a person's accounts on other sites or look anyone up by email or username.
capabilities: Search videos, news and country trends
Read web pages and their link previews
defaultPrompt: Read the public profile at this link.
What videos and news were published about urban gardening this week?
What is trending in Brazil today?
